verdict.rationale: Trello documents visual tracking of task progress, and users describe list-based status workflows (Idea => Doing => Done), adding people to cards, and labels. Card badges via Power-Ups can surface extra data, so status tracking is covered, but there is no explicit evidence of a priority field or of assigning an owning team to an initiative. missing for 10: documented priority field, owning-team attribute or custom fields, initiative-level (cross-board) tracking, independent corroboration of PM initiative tracking.
